As a consequence of a recent result of Bondarenko et al. on the existence of spherical designs with appropriate number of points, we show that minimizers of the $N$-point energy for the reproducing kernel for $H^s(S^d)$, $s>d/2$, form a sequence of QMC designs for $H^s(S^d)$.
